description: Language-neutral parity catalog for the resolver (bin/lib/resolver.py <-> cli/src/core/resolver.ts). Each case declares a fixture vault (verb dirs across engine bin/, plugins/<pack>/, and PLAINKEEP_PATH roots) plus invocations; test/run_core_parity.py builds the vault and runs BOTH the compiled binary's --core-resolve/--core-api and the untouched Python resolver, comparing exit code + exact stdout. Fixture grammar: verbs[].at is 'engine' | 'plugin:<pack>' | 'path:<ref>'; verbs[].files subset of ['run.py','cmd.json'] (default both); path_roots[] give the ordered PLAINKEEP_PATH roots ({ref, under:'vault'|'home', tilde:bool}); an invocation may override the PLAINKEEP_PATH order via path_order (a list of refs) to exercise per-call env re-reads.

cases.name: precedence-collision-and-shadow
cases.rationale: Two plugins/ packs, plugin-plugin collision (earlier pack wins), a plugin shadowing an engine name (ignored + listed by shadowed()), and a PLAINKEEP_PATH root that always loses. Exercises resolve/source_of/known_verbs/plugin_names/shadowed/iter_cmds ordering and the unknown-verb exit-4 contract in one vault. Mirrors run_resolver.py's _resolver_precedence matrix.

cases.name: ordered-path-roots-per-call-reread
cases.rationale: Multiple ordered PLAINKEEP_PATH roots defining the same verb: default order resolves to the earlier root, and an invocation that overrides path_order flips the result in a FRESH process, proving neither side caches env across calls (per-call re-read of PLAINKEEP_PATH).

cases.name: duplicate-pack-name-dedupe
cases.rationale: A plugins/ pack and a PLAINKEEP_PATH root share the same basename ('dup'); both contribute verbs but plugin_names() must list the name once (dedupe), while each root's own verb still resolves to source plugin:dup.

cases.name: verb-dir-shapes
cases.rationale: cmd.json-only and run.py-only verb dirs: both are resolvable (_is_verb_dir = run.py OR cmd.json), but --core-resolve (run_py) exits 4 for the cmd.json-only dir and 0 for the run.py-only dir, and iter_cmds lists only the cmd.json-bearing dir.

cases.name: tilde-in-plainkeep-path
cases.rationale: A PLAINKEEP_PATH entry written as '~/homeroot' must be expanded via $HOME identically on both sides (Python os.path.expanduser, TS process.env.HOME), resolving its verb to an absolute path under the fixture home.

cases.name: engine-runpy-only-iter-cmds-quirk
cases.rationale: Faithful-to-Python edge: iter_cmds seeds its 'seen' set only from engine *cmd.json* dirs, so a run.py-only engine verb does NOT suppress a same-named plugin cmd.json in iter_cmds, even though source_of still resolves it to 'engine' and shadowed() still reports the collision. Locks the port to the original's exact quirk.
